channel.title: Sound baths in Colorado Springs · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Colorado Springs, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Communal Quartz Sound Bath
item.description: A quartz crystal sound bath led by clergy member Oracle Richard at the Colorado Psychedelic Church's Colorado Springs location, with optional group sharing afterward. Where: Colorado Psychedelic Church, Colorado Springs. Price: Donation. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/communal-quartz-sound-bath-2026-09-07-colorado-psychedelic-church/

item.title: Community Sound Bath
item.description: A community sound bath hosted by Colorful Sound Vibrations at The Next Us in Colorado Springs, Wednesday evening; $29. Where: The Next Us, Colorado Springs. Price: $29. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/community-sound-bath-2026-09-09-the-next-us/

item.title: Floating Sound Bath – Elise Nicole
item.description: A sound bath workshop where participants are cocooned in a silk aerial hammock (mat option also available) while Elise Nicole Kirkpatrick leads a healing meditative sound bath. Where: Camino Massage Therapy, Colorado Springs. Price: $45. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/floating-sound-bath-elise-nicole-2026-09-09-camino-massage-therapy/

item.title: New Moon Cave of the Winds Sound Bath
item.description: A new-moon sound bath inside Cave of the Winds Mountain Park in Manitou Springs (Colorado Springs), led by Singing Bowls of the Rockies with Tibetan and crystal bowls, gongs, and flute; Friday night, $71.21. Where: Cave of the Winds Mountain Park, Colorado Springs. Price: $71.21. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/new-moon-cave-of-the-winds-sound-bath-2026-09-11-cave-of-the-winds-mountain-park/

item.title: Colorado Salt Cave w/Sound Healing
item.description: A 90-minute Sunday-afternoon session in the Colorado Salt Cave, Colorado Springs: 20-30 minutes of conscious-connected breathwork followed by 30 minutes of sound healing tuned to 432 Hz; $65. Where: Colorado Salt Cave, Colorado Springs. Price: $65. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/colorado-salt-cave-wsound-healing-2026-09-13-colorado-salt-cave/

item.title: Stretch & Sound
item.description: A recurring hour-long class at The Next Us pairing gentle restorative stretching with soothing sound to release tension and calm the mind. Where: The Next Us, Colorado Springs. Price: $25 per class (+ fees; $28.52 total via Eventbrite). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/stretch-sound-2026-09-14-the-next-us/

item.title: Vagus Nerve Activation Sound Bath – Reconnect with Inner Peace
item.description: A sound bath on crystal and Tibetan singing bowls focused on stimulating the vagus nerve and the parasympathetic nervous system, at Singing Bowls of the Rockies, Colorado Springs, Friday evening; $43. Where: Singing Bowls of the Rockies, Colorado Springs. Price: $43. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/vagus-nerve-activation-sound-bath-reconnect-with-inner-peace-2026-09-18-singing-bowls-of-the-rockies/

item.title: Reiki & Sound Bath feat. Megan & Valeria
item.description: Megan Odom and Valeria Mendoza combine Reiki healing with a live crystal singing bowl sound bath at Singing Bowls of the Rockies on September 18, 2026, priced at $45. Where: Singing Bowls of the Rockies, Colorado Springs. Price: $45. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/reiki-sound-bath-feat-megan-valeria-2026-09-18-singing-bowls-of-the-rockies/

item.title: Listening to Body Wisdom: Building Self-Trust
item.description: Megan Odom leads a body-awareness and journaling workshop that concludes with a live singing bowl sound bath at Singing Bowls of the Rockies on September 20, 2026, priced at $39. Where: Singing Bowls of the Rockies, Colorado Springs. Price: $39. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/listening-to-body-wisdom-building-selftrust-2026-09-20-singing-bowls-of-the-rockies/

item.title: Communal Quartz Sound Bath
item.description: A communal quartz-bowl sound bath at the Colorado Psychedelic Church on N Academy Blvd, Colorado Springs, Monday evening; $10. Where: Colorado Psychedelic Church, Colorado Springs. Price: $10. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/communal-quartz-sound-bath-2026-09-21-colorado-psychedelic-church/

item.title: Autumn Equinox Sound Bath
item.description: An evening sound bath at the Singing Bowls of the Rockies studio marking the autumn equinox, using singing bowls and other overtone instruments for deep rest. Where: Singing Bowls of the Rockies, Colorado Springs. Price: $39 per person (+ fees; $43.45 total via Eventbrite). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/autumn-equinox-sound-bath-2026-09-22-singing-bowls-of-the-rockies/

item.title: Full Moon Cave of the Winds Sound Bath
item.description: A sound bath held inside Cave of the Winds' natural cave chambers using Tibetan and crystal singing bowls, gongs, Native American flute, guitar, and handpan. Hosted by Dr. Gigi Turner, founder of Singing Bowls of the Rockies. Where: Cave of the Winds Mountain Park, Colorado Springs. Price: $71.21 (Eventbrite price, incl. fees). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/full-moon-cave-of-the-winds-sound-bath-2026-09-25-cave-of-the-winds-mountain-park/

item.title: Ground & Grow Parent + Child Wellness Experience
item.description: A parent-and-child wellness workshop that includes a grounding circle, movement and music play, a soothing sound bath with guided meditation, and an emotion-regulation activity. Where: Pikes Peak Library District - Old Colorado City Library, Colorado Springs. Price: $5-$48.80 (sliding scale via Eventbrite). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/ground-grow-parent-child-wellness-experience-2026-09-26-pikes-peak-library-district-old-colorado-city-library/

item.title: Community Sound Bath : A Space For Hope
item.description: A free, donation-based community sound bath held during Suicide Prevention Month, using singing bowls and other instruments for nervous-system regulation; no meditation or sound-bath experience required. Where: The Next Us, Colorado Springs. Price: Free / donation-based ($0-$55.20 suggested tiers). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/community-sound-bath-a-space-for-hope-2026-09-26-the-next-us/

item.title: Havest Full Moon in Aries Sound Bath
item.description: A grounding full-moon sound bath at the Singing Bowls of the Rockies studio inviting participants to release and reset using singing bowls and overtone instruments. Where: Singing Bowls of the Rockies, Colorado Springs. Price: $39 per person (+ fees; $43.45 total via Eventbrite). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/havest-full-moon-in-aries-sound-bath-2026-09-27-singing-bowls-of-the-rockies/

item.title: Sound Healing Dreamscape Concert in a Cave
item.description: A live organic-and-electronic sound healing concert staged inside a primitive cave at Cave of the Winds, combining quartz crystal instruments and world instruments. Facilitated by Denver-based musician Tommy Dill under his Soundularity project. Where: Cave of the Winds Mountain Park, Colorado Springs. Price: $49.87 (Eventbrite price, incl. fees). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sound-healing-dreamscape-concert-in-a-cave-2026-09-27-cave-of-the-winds-mountain-park/
